Identicon Generator

Create symmetric 5×5 pixel identicons hashed from any text — same text always gives the same icon. Download as PNG.

Same text = same identicon, every time.

📖 How to use

  1. Type any text (name, email, username).
  2. Press Generate Identicon.
  3. Download the PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the identicon made?

Your text is hashed (FNV-1a); the hash picks the color and fills a 5×5 grid mirrored left-to-right for symmetry.

Is it deterministic?

Yes — identical text always produces the identical identicon.

What can I download?

The icon renders on canvas and downloads as a crisp PNG.

What text should I use?

Type anything — a name, email, or username — and press Generate.
